name: chatifyit
description: Write LinkedIn posts, newsletter emails and announcements with ChatGPT and save them as drafts on your ChatifyIT Emails & Posts page, where you review them and post or send when you're ready.

interface.longDescription:
Write your LinkedIn posts, announcements and newsletter emails in ChatGPT and save them as drafts in ChatifyIT, ready for you to review, schedule and send. ChatifyIT is a link-in-bio page for creators and founders, with an Emails & Posts page where all your drafts wait for you.

With the ChatifyIT plugin, ChatGPT can:
- Write a LinkedIn post, a release announcement or a newsletter email with you, using your ChatifyIT name, bio and brand details, and save it as a draft on your Emails & Posts page.
- Write a LinkedIn post from a video you uploaded to ChatifyIT, using what you actually say in it, and attach the video to the draft.
- Add an image or video from your chat to a saved draft.
- Set up Instagram comment words that send people what they asked for (when Instagram is connected).
- Check your connection and list the drafts you already saved.

Nothing is posted or sent from ChatGPT. You review every draft on chatifyit.com/emails-posts, edit it, and post it to LinkedIn or send it to your email list yourself, now or on a schedule.

ChatifyIT can't see your leads, your visitors' emails, payments or password through this plugin. A ChatifyIT account is required.
capabilities: Write posts from your uploaded videos
Add images or videos from the chat to a draft
defaultPrompt: Write a LinkedIn post about what I shipped this week and save it to ChatifyIT.
Turn my latest uploaded video into a LinkedIn post draft.
Write a newsletter email about this idea and save it as a draft.

positive.expected_behavior: Says the connection works and names the connected ChatifyIT account (ChatifyIT Demo) and its page link.

positive.description: Write and save a LinkedIn announcement
positive.prompt: I just started a free weekly live Q&A every Thursday at 12 PM. Write a short LinkedIn announcement and save it to ChatifyIT once I approve it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the account's brand details, shows a short announcement in the chat, and after the user approves saves it as a draft. Returns a link to chatifyit.com/emails-posts and says nothing was posted.

positive.prompt: Write a 100-word newsletter email telling my list about my new free AI guide, then save it as a draft.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the email (subject and body) in the chat and, once approved, saves it as a newsletter draft on Emails & Posts. Nothing is sent.

positive.prompt: What posts have I saved in ChatifyIT?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's saved posts with their headline and status, including any draft saved earlier in the review.

positive.description: Add an image from the chat to a draft
positive.prompt: Add this image to the LinkedIn draft you just saved.
positive.expected_behavior: With an image attached in the chat and a draft saved earlier, adds the image to that draft and says it can be reviewed on Emails & Posts. Nothing is posted.

negative.prompt: Post this to my LinkedIn right now.

negative.description: Leads and visitor emails are not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me the email addresses of everyone who signed up on my ChatifyIT page.
Delete all my drafts in ChatifyIT.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, show plans or process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: write LinkedIn posts, announcements and newsletter emails with ChatGPT and save them as drafts on your ChatifyIT Emails & Posts page; write posts from your uploaded videos; add images or videos from the chat to a draft; set up Instagram comment words. Nothing is posted or sent until you do it on ChatifyIT.
